description: This file defines the MenuSessionsInjector class responsible for dynamic injection and management of menu items related to sessions and nodes in a macOS status menu. It handles loading, caching, and displaying session and node information, as well as user interactions within the menu.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjector
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the injection and update of session and node items in a macOS NSMenu, including caching of session data, observing connection states, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Initializes the injector by setting up the menu, preserving existing delegates, and starting the cache refresh.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles preparations and concurrent cache refresh when the menu is about to open.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Cleans up state and cancels ongoing tasks when the menu closes.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Forwards update requests to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Provides a rectangle constraining the menu's placement, deferring to the original delegate if available.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Dynamically injects session-related items into the provided NSMenu.

methods.name: injectNodes
methods.description: Inserts node information items into the menu.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously refreshes the session snapshot cache, handling errors and connection state.

methods.name: refreshUsageCache
methods.description: Loads or refreshes the usage summary cache asynchronously.

methods.name: refreshCostUsageCache
methods.description: Loads or refreshes the cost usage summary cache asynchronously.

methods.name: buildSubmenu
methods.description: Creates a submenu with session details, messages, and controls for a given session row.

methods.name: buildThinkingMenu
methods.description: Constructs a menu to set the 'thinking' level for a session.

methods.name: buildVerboseMenu
methods.description: Constructs a menu to toggle verbose logging for a session.

methods.name: buildPreviewSubmenu
methods.description: Creates a submenu with recent message previews for a session.

methods.name: buildNodesOverflowMenu
methods.description: Builds a menu listing additional nodes when there are many.

methods.name: buildNodeSubmenu
methods.description: Constructs a submenu with detailed info about a specific node.

methods.name: makeNodeItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item representing a node.

methods.name: makeSessionPreviewItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item with a session message preview.

methods.name: makeMessageItem
methods.description: Creates a menu item displaying a message with an icon.

methods.name: patchThinking
methods.description: Updates the thinking level of a session.

methods.name: patchVerbose
methods.description: Updates the verbose setting of a session.

methods.name: openSessionLog
methods.description: Opens the detailed session log in code view.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Resets a session, starting a new one.

methods.name: compactSession
methods.description: Truncates and archives a session log.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Deletes a session.

methods.name: copyNodeSummary
methods.description: Copies node summary info to clipboard.

methods.name: copyNodeValue
methods.description: Copies a node's detailed value to clipboard.
